title: Row menu and right-click menu follow the object action layout's record order (after #36366)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Source: the maintainer's two decisions in the action-format analysis thread on 2026-11-22 (14:27Z 「放在对象上,分列表和记录」; 14:33Z 「三类都由动作声明,分两步做」), filed by the seat. Builds after #36366 lands. Not claimed.

## What changes

#36366 adds an object-level action layout (`actionLayout`, working name) with a `record` arm `{ pinned, more }` that orders the record header, side preview and phone bar. The grid's row menu (⋯) and right-click menu still use today's default order.

## What should happen

The row menu and the right-click menu read the same `record` arm order: pinned first, then more, in the arm's order; an action in neither list goes last in today's default order. #36289's lower half (the whole-row actions in the cell right-click menu) uses the same order.

## Done when

- On an object with a `record` arm, the row ⋯ menu and the right-click menu list actions in the arm's order.
- An object without the arm draws exactly as today (pinned).
